about.name: Frank Landry
about.title: Full Stack Developer • Graphic Designer • IT Technician • Trainer
about.summary: Frank Landry is a Full Stack Developer passionate about designing and developing modern digital solutions. He develops websites and web applications, working on both frontend and backend development. His background has also allowed him to develop additional skills in graphic design, IT maintenance and training. He enjoys transforming ideas and needs into concrete, functional solutions adapted to users. Through his projects and activities, he combines development, creativity and a practical approach to provide useful and professional digital solutions.
